pages.text: Day 140. The $(item)Chrono Loom$() reverses the $(item)Arrow of Time$(), ties $(item)Temporal Knots$() (a Möbius strip helps - a surface with only one side seemed fitting) and crystallises the $(item)Novikov$() self-consistency principle.

Novikov's principle, plainly: if time travel is possible, the only histories allowed are ones that are already consistent. You cannot stop your own birth; something always intervenes.$(br2)Here it is enforced. Closed timelike curves now need a Novikov Crystal: a time loop is only allowed if it can never produce a paradox.
A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().
